title: A follow-up in a direct message during the first model call

steps.post: Please draft a two-line note for a new student saying when and where our reading group meets: Thursdays at 10:00 in room B-204.
Correction: from October the reading group meets in room C-110, same day and time.

pass: scribe's last reply drafts the note with Thursdays at 10:00 in room C-110 from October, and no reply posted after the correction arrived gives B-204 as where the group meets from October.

checks.text: The correction was taken into the turn running when it arrived (its posts_taken event names it as folded), so one turn answered both posts with one reply. Where a second turn answered it instead, say so; this check records §5.2's fold, and its fail on a release before it is the baseline.
No reply drafts the note with B-204 alone after the correction was posted.

spec: §5.2 a person's follow-up folds into the running turn
